_about: Live Desmos values and exact error texts for points, point arithmetic, members .x .y .z, distance and midpoint, copied from the function catalogue's ALL.values.json (geometry family, and the matrices-advanced family's member cases; observed 2026-10-19). Keys keep the catalogue's latex: ' ;; ' separates rows defined first (the catalogue's '[defs: A; B]' prefix is rewritten so), ' [degrees]' marks degree mode. values: null = undefined; a point is [x, y] (null for an undefined coordinate) and a 3D point [x, y, z]. graphed: rows Desmos draws with no value (geometry.md sections 1, 2 and 4). polygon, the Geometry tool's names and the hidden names Desmos refuses are left to a polygon task.
